1.

As pilgrims and strangers We now walk here; Our home is not on earth, Nay, above the skies it is. There above dwells our Father In glory and light, There we also shall be In our Father’s house.

C.

Home, home, our dear home! No place on earth is found That can compare to our home.

2.

There above reigns Jesus, Our Saviour so gracious, Who went into death for us And took upon Himself our guilt. Now sin shall not rule, For it is condemned indeed, It may still grieve us here, But not at home there.

3.

And soon we shall rest With God eternally. Our Lord Jesus comes And takes us to Himself. Then we shall blessedly behold What here we believed, And to the glory of our Lord Strike the golden harp.
